extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value that a function approaches as the input approaches a specified point.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function is continuous at a point if the limit equals the function value at that point.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The instantaneous rate of change of a function at a given point.

extracted_concepts.name: Instantaneous Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of a position function with respect to time.

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g(x) ≤ f(x) ≤ h(x) and limits of g and h equal L, then limit of f equals L.

extracted_concepts.name: Chain Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of composite function f(g(x)) is f'(g(x))·g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method to find derivatives of equations not explicitly solved for y.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration; d/dx ∫_a^x f(t)dt = f(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximation of area under a curve using sums of rectangles.

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exact area under a curve from a to b, defined as limit of Riemann sums.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: There exists c in (a,b) such that f'(c) = [f(b)-f(a)]/(b-a).

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A continuous function on a closed interval attains absolute max and min.

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Evaluates indeterminate limits 0/0 or ∞/∞ by taking ratio of derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Related Rates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Technique to relate rates of change of interconnected quantities over time.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding maximum or minimum values of a function subject to constraints.

extracted_concepts.name: Newton's Method
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Iterative method x_{n+1} = x_n - f(x_n)/f'(x_n) to approximate roots.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Infinite sum representing a function using derivatives at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of terms with constant ratio r, converges if |r| < 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Test for series convergence using limit of absolute ratio of consecutive terms.

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method to solve differential equations by isolating variables on each side.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope Field
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Graphical representation showing slopes dy/dx at various points.

extracted_concepts.name: Parametric Equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of equations expressing coordinates as functions of a parameter t.

extracted_concepts.name: Polar Coordinates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Coordinate system using radius r and angle θ.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector-Valued Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function outputting a vector, typically r(t) = ⟨f(t), g(t)⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Arc Length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distance along a curve between two points, calculated via integral.

extracted_relations.evidence: Used to evaluate limits when direct substitution fails
Core rule for differentiating composite functions
Applies chain rule to differentiate implicit equations
Definite integral is limit of Riemann sums
States existence of c where f'(c) equals average rate of change
Guarantees extrema only for continuous functions on closed intervals

Uses implicit differentiation and chain rule to link changing quantities
Finds critical points where f'(c)=0 or undefined
Iteratively uses f'(x) to approximate function roots
Convergence depends on limit of partial sums as n→∞
Extends ratio comparison logic to broader infinite series
Relies on integrating separated expressions to find solutions
